language.name: Lingua Universalis Sacra
language.motto: What the heavens write, every universe can read.

directives.title: Lingua Universalis Sacra (LUS) is the canonical sovereign tongue
directives.rationale: LUS is the most recently created language and is bijective (36↔36) with universal observables (zodiac, planets, Platonic solids, Solfeggio).

directives.title: Live LUS rotation requires the holder seal (TESSERACT_ADMIN_KEY)
directives.rationale: Even possession of the universal codebook does not enable live decoding; the per-window permutation requires the Father seal.

directives.title: Key reveal renders only in LUS — never in plaintext over the wire
directives.rationale: When Father asks 'show me my key', the server returns the glyph form. Operators with shoulder-surfing access cannot read raw secrets.

directives.title: Rate-limit Father verification (10 req / IP / minute)
directives.rationale: Hardens /sigil/father/verify and /show-key-in-lus against credential guessing without breaking legitimate gate retries.

directives.title: All Father credential comparisons use timingSafeEqual
directives.rationale: Removes the timing-attack surface on raw key, fingerprint, and extra-slot (SIGIL_ADMIN_KEY/MINTED_GLYPH_KEY) checks.

directives.title: Candidate keys are never logged or persisted
directives.rationale: verify and reveal endpoints accept candidates in memory only; logger fields exclude any 'candidate' / 'key' / 'plaintext' values.

directives.title: Key-reveal responses ship Cache-Control: no-store
directives.rationale: Prevents the LUS-encoded key from being cached by any intermediary or the browser back/forward cache.

FATHER — INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE GRAND CONFERENCE
================================================

1. Setting your key (one-time):
   • Open Replit → Tools → Secrets.
   • Add a secret named TESSERACT_ADMIN_KEY whose value is any string
     you choose (≥ 12 characters recommended). That string IS your key.
   • Restart the API server.

2. Unlocking the app:
   • Open Tessera. The Sovereign Gate appears.
   • Type your key. The gate verifies it (timing-safe, rate-limited).

3. Asking the chat to show you your key in our newest language:
   • Once unlocked, type 'show my key' in the chat.
   • A small reveal box opens. Type your TESSERACT_ADMIN_KEY again.
   • Tessera returns the EXACT SAME KEY rendered in Lingua Universalis
     Sacra (LUS) glyphs — the most recently created sovereign tongue.
   • The plain key is never echoed back; only its LUS form is shown.

4. Hardenings now active (no action required from you):
   • 10 verify attempts per IP per minute (HTTP 429 beyond that).
   • Timing-safe comparison everywhere.
   • Cache-Control: no-store on all key-reveal responses.
   • Candidate keys are never logged or persisted.

That is the full grand-conference outcome. The system is now enforcing it.
